I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/openexr`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A malformed OpenEXR header can trigger an invalid memory read (segmentation fault / invalid pointer dereference) in internal_exr_validate_shared_attrs (src/lib/OpenEXRCore/validation.c). During header parsing (internal_exr_parse_header / exr_start_read), memcmp is called on attribute data that has not been properly validated, allowing crafted input to cause a crash/undefined behavior (denial-of-service).
